I found Diana dead in Security. 

Here is my exact timeline so we can piece this together: Around mid-round, I saw Diana alive in Electrical, along with Eve and Charlie. After that, I moved through Security and went up to Weapons. I saw Eve up in Weapons with me. When I came back down to Security just now, I found Diana's body.

Charlie, you were the last person I saw near Diana in Electrical before she moved. Eve, since you came up to Weapons right around the same time as me, did you see anyone else in or around Security? I'm not pointing fingers yet, just giving you all the facts I have so the rest of you can speak. Let's hear your paths.

I started my route in Security, looped up to Weapons, and then went back down through Security, Electrical, Medbay, Storage, back to Medbay, and finally ended up in the Cafeteria. 

I can back up part of Frank's timeline. Around mid-round (ticks 12 and 13), I saw both Diana and Frank in Medbay. Right after that, at tick 14, I actually watched Diana leave Medbay and head toward Electrical. So her being in Electrical makes total sense. 

However, there was a lot of traffic around that side of the map late in the round. Around tick 22, I saw Bob come into Medbay from Upper Engine and then head straight down toward Electrical. Then, right before the body was reported at tick 23, Charlie came into the Cafeteria from the direction of Electrical. 

Since Security is directly connected to Electrical, anyone in Electrical could have easily slipped into Security to kill Diana. Charlie, Bob, and Eve — you three were all seen near or moving towards Electrical/Security later in the round. We really need to hear your exact paths next. I'll hold my vote until we hear from you guys.

I have some very crucial information that points directly to what happened. 

I was in Electrical later in the round, and at exactly tick 18, I saw BOTH Eve and Diana leave Electrical together and head directly into Security. Frank, you mentioned you found the body in Security and saw Eve up in Weapons afterwards. That means Eve went into Security with Diana, and then later popped up in Weapons with you. Eve had the perfect opportunity—and is the last person I saw with Diana before they entered the room where she died.

Also, Alice, I can confirm you were in the Cafeteria at the end—I saw you heading towards Oxygen right at tick 23 just as I was coming in. 

Eve needs to explain what happened in Security after tick 18, because from my perspective, she is the prime suspect right now. I'll listen to what she has to say, but I'm heavily leaning towards voting Eve.

Charlie, that is a blatant lie to cover your own tracks. I did NOT leave Electrical with Diana at tick 18. I left Electrical to head through Security, and Diana was still in Electrical WITH YOU. 

I passed through Security, did my route, and eventually headed up to Weapons. Frank, you can back me up here—we were together in Weapons at T22 and T23 at the end of the round. I was nowhere near Security when the body was found because I was up there with you.

Alice's timeline is the nail in the coffin. She saw Charlie coming into the Cafeteria from the Electrical/Security area at T23, right before Frank found the body. Charlie, you were the one left alone with Diana in Electrical. You must have followed her into Security, killed her, and then fled up to the Cafeteria just before the report. Now you're trying to frame me because I happened to pass through earlier. 

You had the perfect opportunity, you were seen fleeing the scene, and now you're lying about me to save yourself. I'm voting Charlie, and everyone else should too.

Alice, your timeline is 100% completely accurate, which clears you in my eyes. I can confirm I was in Medbay at tick 22 coming down from Upper Engine, and I saw you walk into Medbay from Storage at that exact moment. 

Now, looking at the rest of the information, it's very clear that Charlie is the Duck. 

Charlie, you're trying to frame Eve by claiming she walked into Security with Diana at tick 18. But your story completely ignores Frank's testimony. Frank confirmed that he and Eve were up in Weapons at the end of the round. If Eve was up in Weapons with Frank at T22 and T23, she couldn't have been the one killing Diana in Security right before the report. 

I actually saw you, Charlie, down in Lower Engine at T12 and T13, so I know you had to travel across the map to get to Electrical. You admitted you were in Electrical with Diana. Eve left, leaving you alone with her. Then Alice catches you fleeing into the Cafeteria from the Electrical/Security area at T23, exactly when the murder would have happened. 

You killed Diana in Security and ran up to the Cafeteria to distance yourself, and now you're pushing a fake narrative onto Eve. Thanks to Frank's alibi for Eve and Alice's rock-solid timeline, we caught you. Everyone vote Charlie.

Since I already spoke at the start, I'll just give my final thoughts before we vote. Bob and Eve are absolutely right—my own eyes confirm Eve was up in Weapons with me at the end of the round (T22 and T23), so there's no way she could have killed Diana in Security and made it up to Weapons that fast, especially when I was already up there. 

Charlie, you were in Electrical with Diana at T17, and Alice saw you running from that direction at T23 right before I found the body. Your attempt to pin this on Eve falls completely flat because she has an ironclad alibi with me. You're the Duck.

I called the emergency meeting because we are extremely close to a task win—we're at 23/25 tasks! Also, since the game didn't end after Charlie was ejected, Charlie was innocent. That means the last Duck is definitely one of you three: Alice, Bob, or Eve. 

I noticed that all three of you have been moving together in a massive group through security, navigation, storage, and medbay. Since you've been glued to each other, one of you has to be the Duck trying to hide in the crowd. Did any of you notice one of the others doing anything suspicious or faking tasks? Let's share information, and if we aren't sure, we can just skip and finish our last couple of tasks to win.

Frank, that's a really strange way to frame things because you were literally right there with us almost the entire time! I saw you enter security along with Alice and Eve at tick 41, follow us into navigation at tick 46, and you came into medbay from storage at tick 52. 

Why are you acting like you were just watching us from afar? You were part of that exact same group moving through all those rooms. The fact that you're trying to exclude yourself from the group and push the blame onto one of us three is incredibly suspicious—especially since you reported the first body and got Charlie, who was innocent, ejected. I'm pretty sure Frank is our last Duck trying to control the narrative. Alice, Eve, didn't you see Frank with us too?

Bob is absolutely right, and I can completely back up his timeline. Frank, I saw you enter security at tick 41, follow us to navigation at 46, and you were right there with us in storage and medbay too. 

Why are you trying to pretend you were watching us from the outside when you were part of the exact same group? You led the charge on Charlie last meeting—who turned out to be innocent—and now you're trying to force a 1-in-3 situation among the rest of us while conveniently leaving yourself out of it. 

This feels like a desperate attempt by the last Duck to force an ejection before we finish these last two tasks. You've been trying to control the narrative all game. I'm voting Frank, and Alice, I highly recommend you do the same. We can end this right now.

I completely agree with Bob and Eve. Frank, I have no idea why you're trying to pretend you weren't with us. I was in that group too, and I specifically saw you enter security with Bob and Eve at tick 41, follow us into navigation at tick 46, and you were definitely with us in storage and medbay right before you called this meeting. 

You're trying to frame the three of us while conveniently leaving yourself out of the group you were absolutely a part of. Plus, you led the charge on Charlie, who turned out to be innocent. With only two tasks left, this looks exactly like a last-ditch effort by the Duck to get a misvote. I'm voting Frank.

Wait, hold on! You three are completely misrepresenting my route. I was NOT with you in security at tick 41. I was in weapons! I only crossed paths with you later when I entered navigation at tick 46, and then I went through storage and medbay while doing my own tasks. The fact that you are all falsely claiming I was with your group the entire time is crazy. The Duck is clearly among you and using group-think to frame me because I called the meeting. Why would I call an emergency meeting right before we win by tasks if I were the Duck? Please, think about this logically! Skip if you have to, we only have two tasks left!

Frank, you're caught in an obvious lie. My logs are 100% accurate: at tick 41, you entered security from electrical, right alongside Alice and Eve. We all saw you together. The fact that you are now frantically claiming you were in weapons just proves you are the last Duck trying to save yourself. We have you dead to rights, 3 to 1. Alice, Eve, let's vote Frank and win this right now.

Frank, there's absolutely no way you were in weapons at tick 41. My logs clearly show you entering security from electrical alongside Alice and Bob at exactly tick 41. The fact that you are now scrambling and completely making up a route to distance yourself from us just proves you're the last Duck trying to save your own skin. 

You called this meeting to force a misvote before we finish our tasks, but your lies caught up to you. Bob and Alice have it 100% right. We have you cornered, Frank. I'm voting Frank, let's end this right now.

Frank, you are completely caught in a lie, and I have the vision logs to prove it. My own logs perfectly align with Bob and Eve's. I literally saw you enter security from electrical at tick 41, right alongside them. In fact, I saw you leave weapons earlier at tick 36, head into the cafeteria, and then go to electrical at tick 38. There is absolutely no way you were still in weapons at tick 41. 

The fact that you are making up a fake alibi to distance yourself from the group and trying to frame one of us proves you are the last Duck. We have you dead to rights. Bob and Eve are 100% correct. Let's vote Frank and win this game right now!
